turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
Carbs — yes, today is a good day to pull that lever, especially if the hunger is hitting hard. Adding a portion of rice, sweet potato, or oats to your meals today will help fuel you up and settle that appetite. 

Before training tomorrow — since you're training in the morning, you want something fast-digesting about 30 to 60 minutes before you start so it doesn't sit heavy. A banana and a slice of toast with a little honey is a perfect, simple setup for quick energy. 

Stretching — it is completely fine that you skipped it. Missing a stretch at the end of a session won't set you back at all. Sleep, hydration, and getting those extra carbs in today will do infinitely more for your recovery than a few minutes of stretching anyway. 

How does that breakfast idea sound for tomorrow morning?
